scripts.network: hc s clean && npm run build:happ && UI_PORT=8887 concurrently "npm run dev:libs" "npm run launch:happ" "npm start -w demo"
scripts.dev:libs: concurrently "npm run build:watch -w @holochain-syn/client" "npm run build:watch -w @holochain-syn/store" "npm run build:watch -w @holochain-syn/core" "npm run build:watch -w @holochain-syn/text-editor"
scripts.publish: npm run build:libs && cd packages/client && npm run build && npm publish --access=public && cd ../store && npm run build && npm publish --access=public && cd ../core && npm run build && npm publish --access=public && cd ../text-editor && npm run build && npm publish --access=public
scripts.test: npm run build:happ && npm run build:libs && npm test -w tests
scripts.build:happ: npm run build:dna && hc app pack workdir
scripts.build:dna: npm run build:zome && hc dna pack workdir
scripts.build:zome: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target RUSTFLAGS='--cfg getrandom_backend="custom"' cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
